name: geonnax
description: Write geoscientific neural networks in JAX on geonnax — Fourier / spherical / wavelet neural operators, dimension-flexible U-Nets, SIREN and multiplicative filter networks with FiLM and hypernetwork conditioning, lon/lat and spherical-harmonic encoders, spectral and localized bases with their eigenvalues or geometry, random Fourier features, spectral normalisation, SNGP heads and other deterministic cores for uncertainty-aware models — instead of hand-rolling FFT convolutions, spherical harmonics, sine-network inits and random features.
